page.overview:
Who is Amy Rose?

Amy Rose is a pink female anthropomorphic hedgehog from the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise who has a huge crush on Sonic the Hedgehog. She primarily makes her appearances in the Mario & Sonic installments as one of the participants in the featured Olympic events for each entry as a playable character for Team Sonic.

In Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Games, Amy appears as an All-Around character, featuring good skill and stamina stats, average speed, and below average power.

Amy utilizes some sort of heart power similar to Peach for her special moves. In the Wii version for Amy’s Dream Table Tennis special move, she laughs and hits the ball over the table covered with hearts with a "Go!". It hovers above the table for a second, then plummets down. This move is quite easy to return, but if it isn't it will probably knock the opponent over. In Amy’s fencing special move, she lunges forward, propelled by her heart power in one powerful jab.

In Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Winter Games, Amy appears again as an All-Around character. Her special move has her spinning around with a bunch of hearts saying "Okay". In the Adventure Mode of the DS version, Amy is found in Sparkleton where she will join the player's team if the player beats her in Ski Shooting (Dream Biathlon). In Frostown, there is a mechanism that requires Amy to hit it with her Piko Piko Hammer.
